clause: Format family — PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP web raster (rows 4,5,6,7, SOX) [STU-IO-006]

scope.summary: Implement StudioImportProfile + StudioExportRecipe for the flat-raster web family: .png (row 4, I·X, 8/16-bit + alpha, rasterized on export), .jpg/.jpeg (row 5, I·X, lossy, metadata/ICC preserved, quality options), .gif (row 6, I·X, indexed color + animation frames, editable color table), .webp (row 7, I·X, raster+alpha+animation, lossy/lossless options). Five-artifact gate + fixtures + receipts + recovery each.
acceptance_criteria: PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP I·X with alpha/animation/quality/color-table; fixtures+receipts+recovery; manual entry
proof_targets: web-raster fixtures + round-trip + rasterize-receipt + recovery test
expected_tests: round-trip: flat-raster import->export bounded envelope; alpha/animation/quality/color-table options
receipt: layers-rasterized-on-export receipt; recovery: malformed input fails closed

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Import & Export / PNG, JPEG, GIF & WebP

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
